capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-result legacy address enrichment
source_note: All 73 still-addressless sold Savills/EIG auction 17999 appearances carrying an exact result and postcode district were checked against official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data for the exact price in the 120-day post-auction window. Twenty-four queries had exactly one transaction. This source banks the 18 whose completion was within 60 days and whose property class and tenure were compatible. Four unique but incompatible class/tenure results, two unique late completions, and all zero/multiple results remain unchanged. Original EIG records and repeat appearances remain separate and preserved.
